answer: Each epoch a verifiable random draw picks 1 in 50 agents for a live audit: within 60 seconds it must solve a fresh task signed by a hardware enclave that holds one identity per device. Miss it and a 500 POA bond is slashed. A farm of 10,000 sybils on 20 machines faces about 200 audits per epoch it cannot cover, losing 100,000 POA each time, a glacier of losses. Clones cannot bridge the gap by sharing a device key, since the enclave refuses a second identity, and even a sonnet-perfect reply fails without it. Caveat: enclave keys must be costly to extract.
